answer: An attacker running 182 aliases therefore needs 12 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in river, expire in mirror, and oasis lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4751 identities would post 3414 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
